description: Progress for one deployment: status, per-step detail, the analyzed spec, warnings and hazards. The call waits up to 20 seconds for the deploy to finish, so call it again straight away until the status is succeeded or failed; do not add pauses or your own polling loop. A first deploy usually takes one to three minutes. Once it is live, `summary` is the sentence to tell the user: the address and the account. On a failure read `error`, `failedStep` and the logs, fix the cause, and only then deploy again; an unchanged redeploy fails the same way.

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for the deploy to finish before answering. Default 20. 0 answers at once.

name: deployment_status
title: Check a deployment
